input_contract: Input is an object with a single key "graph" containing an adjacency list (dict) of an undirected graph. Node names are uppercase letters. Output is an object with keys "articulation" (sorted list of articulation point names) and "bridges" (sorted list of bridge edges, each edge sorted within and edges sorted).

variants.name: Tarjan's DFS with dfn/low
variants.strategy: Perform one DFS, maintain dfn, low, and parent arrays. An articulation point is detected when low[v] >= dfn[u] (non-root) or root has >1 children. A bridge is detected when low[v] > dfn[u].

pseudocode: Initialize dfn, low, parent, time
For each unvisited node, perform DFS
Recursive DFS: set dfn/u and low/u, increment time
Process neighbors: tree edge -> recurse, update low, check articulation/bridge
Back edge: update low
Root special case: if children > 1, articulation

variants.name: Naive removal check
variants.strategy: For each vertex, temporarily remove it and run BFS; if not all other vertices are reachable, it is an articulation point. For each edge, temporarily remove it and run BFS; if graph becomes disconnected, it is a bridge.

pseudocode: For each vertex v: temporarily remove v, BFS on remaining graph
If BFS does not visit all other vertices, v is articulation point
For each edge (u,v): temporarily remove edge, BFS on graph
If BFS does not visit all vertices, (u,v) is a bridge
Initialize dfn, low, parent, time
For each unvisited node, perform DFS
Recursive DFS: set dfn/u and low/u, increment time
Process neighbors: tree edge -> recurse, update low, check articulation/bridge
Back edge: update low
Root special case: if children > 1, articulation
